title: Displayed Vertical List

illustrates.quote: Transcribe word lists that contain phrases vertically, with each phrase beginning in cell 1.

blocks.text: How are you at comparing things for different sizes? Read the words. Under which heading would you write each word?

blocks.features: Six words/phrases, one of them multi-word ('hot-air balloon', 'rubber raft'), transcribed vertically with each phrase beginning in cell 1 per 9.2.5d.

blocks.text: A blank three-column answer chart (headed 'Big / Bigger / Biggest') with two blank underline rows per column for the reader to sort the words into.
blocks.features: Rendered in braille as a heading line, a row of guide-dot placeholders, and two rows of blank-answer-line filler cells; no print text to transcribe beyond the three column headings, and Emboss has no ruled-blank-answer-chart/guide-dot mechanism to build the rest from (cf. standards-findings.md F-36, the related skeleton-outline blank-fill gap).

print.notes: Direct worked example of 9.2.5d: each list word/phrase begins in cell 1, one per line, including the two-word phrases.
print.printFeatures: Plain (unboxed) worksheet text; six comparison words/phrases in one row; a 3-column 'Big / Bigger / Biggest' chart with blank underlines beneath each heading for the reader to write in.

braille.notes: Numbered lines 8-23 (a genuine excerpt). Field width 5, stripped. Lines 1-3 (source 8-10): lead-in paragraph, cell 5. Line 4 (11): blank. Lines 5-10 (12-17): the six list words/phrases, each at cell 1. Line 11 (18): blank. Lines 12-15 (19-22): the 'Big/Bigger/Biggest' answer-chart heading, its guide-dot row, and two blank-answer rows. Line 16 (23): blank.

uncertain: The exact braille cell-pattern used for the worksheet's blank ruled answer lines (encoded as repeated '.-' groups) is transcribed verbatim from the ASCII source without independently confirming its dot-pattern meaning against a Special Symbols page.
resolution: A and B transcribed identical `braille.lines`, verified byte-for-byte against lines 6965-6980 after stripping the 5-character line-number field (the '(Return to Text)' line 6981 excluded). `illustrates.rule` narrowed to 9.2.5.d (both runs agreed, dotted per convention). Structural disagreement over the answer-chart block: A recorded it as one non-modelled 'other' block; B modelled it as a second 'list' (items: 'Big'/'Bigger'/'Biggest') which would cause buildModel9 to build an actual formatted list -- not matching the chart's real guide-dot/ruled-blank-line braille at all. Resolved to A's 'other' treatment: Emboss has no mechanism to build a worksheet answer grid (column headings + guide dots + blank ruled lines), so it is recorded as a limitation rather than mis-modelled as an ordinary list.
